proposal.summary: GitLab versions from 4.1 before 16.1.5, 16.2 before 16.2.5, and 16.3 before 16.3.1 contain an issue where it was possible to create a URL that would redirect to a different project.
proposal.affected_product: GitLab all versions starting from 4.1 before 16.1.5; all versions starting from 16.2 before 16.2.5; all versions starting from 16.3 before 16.3.1
proposal.cwe_quote: it was possible to create a URL that would redirect to a different project.

AV.quote: it was possible to create a URL that would redirect to a different project.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the full advisory or vendor bulletin to confirm impact details (whether data disclosure or privilege changes are possible), reproduce the redirect behavior, and verify fixed versions in internal testing; if confirmed, apply the vendor updates listed.

evidence_quotes.quote: An issue has been discovered in GitLab affecting all versions starting from 4.1 before 16.1.5, all versions starting from 16.2 before 16.2.5, all versions starting from 16.3 before 16.3.1 where it was possible to create a URL that would redirect to a different project.
